tests.name: Sodium
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures the level of sodium, an essential electrolyte, in your blood.

tests.name: Potassium
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures the amount of potassium, a mineral that helps your muscles and nerves work properly, in your blood.

tests.name: Chloride
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures chloride, an electrolyte that helps balance fluid levels in your body.

tests.name: Carbon Dioxide (CO2)
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures the level of bicarbonate in your blood to check your body's acid-base balance.

tests.name: BUN
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures blood urea nitrogen to see how well your kidneys are filtering waste.

tests.name: Creatinine
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures creatinine, a waste product cleared by the kidneys, to assess kidney function.

tests.name: eGFR
tests.plain_meaning: This calculates how efficiently your kidneys filter waste based on your blood test results.

tests.name: Glucose, fasting
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures the amount of sugar in your blood after you have fasted.

tests.name: Calcium
tests.plain_meaning: This test measures the total amount of calcium in your blood, important for bones and muscle function.

tests.name: Cholesterol, Total
tests.plain_meaning: This measures the total amount of cholesterol floating in your blood.

tests.name: LDL Cholesterol (calc)
tests.plain_meaning: This measures low-density lipoprotein, often called 'bad' cholesterol.

tests.name: HDL Cholesterol
tests.plain_meaning: This measures high-density lipoprotein, often called 'good' cholesterol.

tests.name: Triglycerides
tests.plain_meaning: This measures a type of fat found in your blood used for energy.

tests.name: ALT (SGPT)
tests.plain_meaning: This measures an enzyme mainly found in liver cells to evaluate liver health.

tests.name: AST (SGOT)
tests.plain_meaning: This measures an enzyme found in the liver and other organs that can indicate tissue damage.

tests.name: Alkaline Phosphatase
tests.plain_meaning: This measures an enzyme related to your bile ducts, liver, and bones.

tests.name: Bilirubin, Total
tests.plain_meaning: This measures a substance made during the normal breakdown of red blood cells.

tests.name: Albumin
tests.plain_meaning: This measures a major protein made by the liver that keeps fluid from leaking out of blood vessels.

tests.name: WBC
tests.plain_meaning: This measures white blood cells, which help your body fight infections.

tests.name: Hemoglobin
tests.plain_meaning: This measures the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen throughout your body.

tests.name: Hematocrit
tests.plain_meaning: This measures the percentage of your total blood volume that is made up of red blood cells.

tests.name: Platelets
tests.plain_meaning: This measures tiny blood cell fragments that help your blood clot.

tests.name: TSH
tests.plain_meaning: This measures thyroid-stimulating hormone to check how well your thyroid is working.

tests.name: Hemoglobin A1c
tests.plain_meaning: This test shows your average blood sugar levels over the past two to three months.
